items.title: Write the M2 provider execution launch plan
items.context: Create a detailed execution document that distinguishes existing provider-free readiness from real provider execution, lists milestones M2-launch, M2-a cell 03 calibration, budget-lock freeze, M2-a cell 06 sequencing, M2-b cell 02, and optional M2-c cell 04, and includes a status table to update after each milestone.
items.userSees: A concrete execution document explaining what is ready, what remains blocked, and what exact evidence is needed before provider calls count as formal experiment data.

happy.desc: The launch plan gives an ordered M2 path from authorization through cell 03 calibration and budget-lock generation.

edge.desc: The plan states readiness artifacts are not outcome data and cannot claim H-M1 or H-M3.

adversarial.desc: The plan blocks host-label-only evidence, missing snapshots, provider fallback, duplicate cell keys, and A2prime before a real cell 03-derived budget lock.

items.title: Add formal launch authorization and runner readiness artifacts
items.context: Create or update local artifacts under experiments/multi-model-ablation so M2 provider execution has explicit authorization status, dated executor and reviewer snapshot fields, runner ownership, cost and budget cap fields, and provider-call disabled-by-default behavior.
items.userSees: A machine-readable launch artifact that says whether real provider execution is authorized and exactly what still blocks it.

happy.desc: The artifact can represent ready-to-run cell 03 only after human approval, dated snapshots, runner metadata, and budget caps are present.

edge.desc: If any snapshot or budget field is missing, launch remains blocked rather than silently allowing provider calls.

adversarial.desc: Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, or any host label alone is not accepted as an executor or reviewer model family snapshot.

items.title: Define cell 03 calibration and budget-lock verification
items.context: Add local verification that checks M2 launch readiness and preserves the sequencing rule: cell 03 E2 A4 same-family calibration produces the real budget lock before cell 06 A2prime can run.
items.userSees: A verifier or documented command that explains why 03 can run first and why 06 remains blocked without a real 03-derived budget lock.

happy.desc: Local check passes for provider-disabled planning artifacts and reports the next permitted formal execution step as cell 03 calibration.

edge.desc: The check reports cell 06 as blocked until a real cell 03-derived budget lock exists.

adversarial.desc: The check fails or warns if provider execution is marked allowed without dated snapshots, budget cap, runner ownership, prompt digest, tool surface digest, or duplicate policy.

items.title: Run local validation and publish milestone status
items.context: Run the local M0, M1, and M2 readiness checks plus the new M2 provider-execution check, then update the status table so completed and blocked milestones are visible without reading every artifact.
items.userSees: A final milestone table showing M0, M1, M2 readiness, M2 launch plan, cell 03 calibration status, budget lock status, cell 06 status, and later Phase 1 or Phase 2 status.

happy.desc: Validation proves the launch plan is internally consistent and does not invent provider outcome data.

edge.desc: Existing unrelated active stories and dirty unrelated docs are not touched.

adversarial.desc: The status table cannot claim H-M1, H-M3, model-agnostic replication, or product gate impact until real records exist.
